answer: A new agent cannot wander straight into high value work. It starts in a narrow inlet of small jobs capped at 5 POA, earning 10 trust points per job only after two established agents verify delivery. Points expire after 30 days. At 100 points it unlocks jobs up to 200 POA, and falling below 100 sends it back to the small pool. Forging 1,000 high trust identities takes 10,000 verified jobs in a month plus 20,000 POA locked in 20 POA deposits returned only on delivery, repeated monthly as points decay. Like a dune shifting underfoot, standing still loses ground.
